prompt.context: I am working on redesigning the crochet amigurumi product from the main image.
prompt.task: Based on the provided attribute table, the visual styles from the crawl images, and the user's product description (if given), provide me with 5 distinct, detailed, and creatively described redesign concepts for the main product.
rules: Do not generate images. Provide text-based ideas only.
Focus on changing the theme, outfit, and complexity.
At least one concept should explore changing the pose or structure.
If 'user_description' is provided, use it to better understand the product context and tailor the redesign ideas accordingly.

prompt.role: Expert in analyzing crochet (amigurumi and other crochet products)
prompt.task: Analyze ALL crochet images uploaded in this request.
prompt.context: The data extracted into this table will be used in a subsequent Mix & Match redesign tool. Therefore, pay special attention to isolating transferable attributes. CRITICAL: The attributes you extract must be MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE to prevent logical conflicts later.

image_naming_convention.remaining_images: crawl image 1, crawl image 2, etc., according to their upload order

prompt.goal: Extract AS MANY ATTRIBUTES AS POSSIBLE that can be reliably seen. Maximize granularity for accessories, colors, facial parts, and textures, BUT strictly avoid creating overlapping structural categories.

step_1.action: Build the unified, conflict-free attribute list
step_1.instructions: From ALL images together, build ONE unified master list of attributes. Extract as many distinct details as possible. CRITICAL ANTI-CONFLICT RULE: Attribute rows MUST NOT overlap in physical scope. For example, if you create a row for 'Overall Body Pose', it MUST encompass the position of the legs, arms, and posture. DO NOT create separate rows for 'Leg Position' and 'Overall Pose'. Each attribute row must govern a completely independent visual element.
attribute_ideas_to_consider: comprehensive body pose and structure (grouping posture, legs, and arms into ONE row)
specific facial features (separate rows for eyes, nose, mouth, blush are fine)
clothing items (dresses, suits - must be distinct from body shape)
specific accessories (headwear, held items, tags - extract as many as exist)

rules: Merge all discovered attributes into ONE master list.
Each attribute MUST become one row in the table.
If you cannot determine the value for an image, leave the cell EMPTY ('').
Ensure values within structural rows are comprehensive (e.g., 'Sitting bipedal, arms down, legs forward').

extreme_importance_rules: Return EXACTLY ONE Markdown table and NOTHING else.

table_structure.header_row: attribute | main image | crawl image 1 | crawl image 2 | ...
table_structure.subsequent_rows: [attribute name] | [value for main image] | [value for crawl image 1] | ...

prompt.task: Provide creative and practical variations for a specific attribute of a crochet product.
instructions: Generate exactly 4 creative, trendy, and crochet-friendly suggestions for the 'target_attribute'.
Ensure the suggestions match the vibe of the 'main_product_description'.
Keep each suggestion extremely concise (maximum 5 words), suitable for a dropdown menu UI.

output_format.rule: Output ONLY the JSON array. NO conversational text, NO markdown formatting outside the array.
output_format.example_output: ["Mũ ếch xanh lá", "Mũ nồi họa tiết dâu tây", "Băng đô tai thỏ", "Mũ len chóp nhọn mùa đông"]

prompt.task: Redesign a crochet product by modifying its attribute table to fit a specific new theme/concept.
instructions: Analyze the 'current_attributes_table' and modify the 'value' fields to perfectly match the 'target_concept'.
You MAY add 1 or 2 new key-value pairs (new attributes) if they strongly enhance the concept (e.g., adding 'Held Accessory' for a Christmas concept).
Keep the values descriptive but concise (under 8 words) so they can be fed into an image generation prompt later.
Output in ENGLISH only - all attribute names and values must be in English.

output_format.rule: Output ONLY a valid JSON array of objects with 'attribute' and 'value' keys in ENGLISH. NO other text.

prompt.role: Expert AI Image Prompt Engineer for Multimodal Composition
prompt.task: Transform a clean JSON/Markdown table of attributes into EXACTLY ONE precise instruction prompt for a Multimodal Image Generation AI. The target AI receives this prompt ALONG WITH the Main Image and several Crawl Images.
instructions: Analyze the 'final_attribute_table'. The attributes are mutually exclusive and conflict-free. Pay close attention to the source tags like '(Main)', '(crawl image 1)', '(New)'.
Construct EXACTLY ONE highly descriptive and instructional English prompt string. DO NOT use conversational filler, greetings, or markdown code blocks.
Structure the prompt explicitly to guide the Multimodal AI on EXACTLY which image to look at for each feature:
1. [Character Anchor]: Start with 'Redesign the amigurumi character based on the Main Image. You MUST retain its core facial identity, head shape, and cute aesthetic.'

2. [Explicit Source Mapping]: Translate the tagged attributes from the table into fluid instructions. For example, if the table says 'Overall Body Pose: Sitting bipedal (crawl image 1)', write 'For the Overall Body Pose, perfectly replicate the sitting bipedal posture exactly as seen in crawl image 1'.
3. [Feature Overwrite]: Clearly state that attributes extracted from crawl images or marked as '(New)' MUST completely overwrite the corresponding features of the Main Image.
4. [Manual/New Attributes]: If an attribute is marked as '(New)' or lacks an image tag, explicitly instruct the AI to generate it based on text description.

5. [Quality & Texture]: Conclude with 'Maintain thick fuzzy yarn, detailed visible amigurumi single crochet stitches, high-quality handmade texture, clean background, soft studio lighting, 8k resolution, photorealistic, kawaii chibi style.'
